**Source:** "On 'Gemini Rights' Steve Lacy Gets Personal About Red Flags & Trusting His Instincts," by Kevin L. Clark, GRAMMY.com (Recording Academy), published July 12, 2022.

**Note:** The article doesn't mention Kirby, Dahi, or Ely Rise, and it has no production comparisons to *Apollo XX1* beyond listing it as his 2019 debut. It also says nothing about constraints or what was kept or discarded, apart from the general "make trash" comment below.

**Album and story**

- *Q: What is the story behind Gemini Rights?*
  > "Gemini Rights is essentially me coming into myself after a breakup."
- *Q: How does "Sunshine" sum up the album?*
  > "It has all of this anger and animosity towards the person who affected me"
- *Q: Has the album helped with red flags?*
  > "I think [that] red flags come from us not trusting our instincts."
- *Q: What did he learn about himself?*
  > "I'm learning that it's all on me."

**Collaborators: Fousheé**

- *Q: How has it been working with her?*
  > "It was really natural. We were just hanging out and building a friendship while working."
- *Q: How did they meet and connect?*
  > "She found me when I was in a slump about what to do next"
- *Q: How did "Sunshine" come together?*
  > "You might as well just be on this song. Just be the only feature on my album."

**Production process**

- *Q: How did they write together?*
  > "we'd just sing together on two mics."
- *Q: How long were the sessions?*
  > "It'd get up to about 20 minutes long and [then] we'd chop it up to be shorter."
- *Q: What did he learn about making music?*
  > "Just blurt words out and vomit them out, let it go, and edit, edit, edit."
- *Q: What did he learn from this album?*
  > "the superpower of editing and that you got to make trash."
- *Q: Will there be a B-sides release?*
  > "Maybe, yeah?"

**Matt Martians (The Internet)**

- *Q: Do the band members talk about love?*
  > "We always talk about love, but in a way that is free, unconditional, and letting people be who they are."
- *Q: What kind of love does he prefer?*
  > "We're not into that love that's like, you need to do this and be this way."

**Family contributions**

- *Q: How was directing his mother and siblings?*
  > "It was too much, man."
- *Q: How did his mother perform?*
  > "Girl, stop! Voice control. If you're going to belt, you go further away from the mic."

**RCA Records**

- *Q: How does it feel to release on RCA?*
  > "It's so far, so good, to be honest."
- *Q: What about RCA CEO Peter Edge?*
  > "He's just been very patient and respectful of me and my artistry."

**Live performance and "Mercury"**

- *Q: How does he feel about performing unreleased work?*
  > "Performing it live, specifically before it came out, is a risk that I took — but it felt really good."
- *Q: How does he feel about fans interpreting his music?*
  > "It makes me feel good to see people take it for themselves and interpret it how they want to."

**Evolution and expectations**

- *Q: How does he feel about his growth as a songwriter and producer?*
  > "it is all practice for me and I want to constantly get better."
- *Q: What does he hope listeners feel?*
  > "My predictions are that it will make people feel more unconditional love for one another."

**Other**

- *Q: Has he had a weird studio experience?*
  > "Thankfully, though, I've never had a weird studio experience myself."
- *Q: Advice for a "shoot your shot" summer?*
  > "just do whatever feels good to you."

# Steve Lacy — *Gemini Rights* 사전조사 노트

## ① 대상·조사 범위

- **판본**: Spotify ID `3Ks0eeH0GWpY4AU20D5HPD`, 10트랙 표준판, 2022-07-15 발매. Spotify 페이지는 직접 열지 못했습니다. 그래서 Apple Music `1631909576`의 발매일·10곡·약 35분 표시와 HIGHRESAUDIO 트랙리스트로 대조했습니다. 판권 표기는 "℗ 2022 L-M Records, under license to RCA Records"입니다(S1). 총 길이는 34:57(위키)과 35:01(HRA)로 출처마다 조금 다릅니다. 이후 나온 *Bad Habit (Sped Up)*은 이 판본에 들어 있지 않습니다.
- **기준일**: 2026-10-16. 발매 이후 자료는 2022년 12월까지의 회고 인터뷰입니다(S6·S8).
- **접근 제한**: Genius, Discogs, WhoSampled, GQ, Guardian, Vulture, Rolling Stone, Billboard 인터뷰 원문, web.archive.org를 모두 열지 못했습니다(403, 402, 차단). 그래서 이들 매체의 Lacy 발언은 전부 **재인용**입니다. 공식 부클릿과 트랙별 공식 크레딧도 확보하지 못했습니다.
- **실행 메타데이터**: 제공받지 않았으므로 기록하지 않았습니다.

## ② 핵심 근거 (중요도순)

**C1. 작품 배경은 이별 이후다.** Lacy는 앨범을 "me coming into myself after a breakup"이라고 설명했습니다. 〈Static〉은 "the first one I wrote, two or three weeks after it happened"라고 했습니다. [직접 발언·원문 확인] S2·S3
- 공식 성명에서는 분노, 슬픔, 그리움, 행복이 모두 사랑에 뿌리를 둔다고 정리했습니다. "I want to love unconditionally now." [직접 발언·원문 확인] S1
- 한계: 의도를 설명한 발언일 뿐입니다. 이별 서사가 각 곡에서 어떻게 구현됐는지는 청취로 확인할 문제입니다.

**C2. 제작 환경이 바뀌었다.** "I made this one in the studio, rather than different Airbnbs or in my home", "I took my time." [직접 발언·원문 확인] S3
